practices: Retain matched sheets for diagnosis, then use an instant one-variant-at-a-time comparison at real application size before selecting a material. Named axes include antenna prominence, outer rim, tonal falloff and available character width.

Judge an expression's lead shape and meaningful hand contact before secondary detailing. Future website chrome, background and copy should remain quiet enough for the character and project cue to carry the scene.
Record the expected gain and tradeoff separately at avatar, small-full-body and stage scale; a cleaner large contour must not silently worsen 32px stem connection.
Preserve the evidence surface and editable variants as review provenance. Record actual skill reading, test modality and source version in each future review.
Require a measured relevant workload before changing filters, path morphing or layering for performance; distinguish source/static/frame-sample/hardware/human findings.
practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.workflowReviewTable:
| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One contact sheet decides every scale | Matched diagnosis plus instant full-size context comparison | Fine contour gains must survive real use |
| Remove all overlapping hand contours | Preserve intentional contact and test pose/overlap clarity | Gratitude should retain a clasp without becoming a ruff-like knot |
| Treat phone width as the whole composition problem | Review width, viewport exposure and eyeline-to-cue relation together | Portrait legibility creates different staging tradeoffs |
| Generic GPU/UI rules override the drawing | Apply rules by purpose and measured cost | Expressive SVG acting and frequent control feedback serve different jobs |
exceptions: Do not compress intentional character scenes into generic sub-300ms UI timing or remove playback when Play is keyboard-activated.
Do not replace expressive SVG geometry merely to satisfy a transform/opacity preference; never enlarge hands or lengthen limbs to hide a scale problem.
Do not add blur, spring bounce, stagger, glass or extra texture as automatic polish.
The prototype workflow is read for comparison discipline, not invoked to demand a new picker or delete required historical evidence.
Desktop snapshots and active cadence do not establish physical-phone behavior, continuous perceptual quality, spoken AT or human attachment.
